{{recipesummary|category=Pasta recipes|servings=4|time=30 minutes|difficulty=3}}{{recipe}}   
{{nutritionsummary|1/4 of recipe (375 g)|4|1042|722|80.2 g|52.1 g|244 mg|1208 mg|51.2 g|2.5 g|4.3 g|28.9 g|10%|4%|67%|7%}}

This dish was developed as a macaroni and cheese dish for adults. Instead of cheddar, this recipe uses Fontina, mascarpone, Gruyere, cream cheese, and Swiss.

== Ingredients ==
*½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (227 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) elbow [[Cookbook:Macaroni|macaroni]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (170 g) heavy [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], plus more for the water
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 g / 2.1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) grated [[Cookbook:Fontina|Fontina]]
*½ cup (60 g / 2.1 oz) grated [[Cookbook:Gruyère Cheese|Gruyere]]
*½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone]] cheese
*½ cup (150 g / 5.3 oz) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
*4 thin slices [[Cookbook:Emmental Cheese|Swiss cheese]], julienned
*1¼ sticks (150 g / 5.3 oz) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (30 ml) all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 tsp (5 ml) [[Cookbook:Tabasco Sauce|tabasco sauce]]

== Procedure ==
#In a gallon (~3.8 L) of salted boiling water, [[Cookbook:Boiled Pasta|cook macaroni]] to [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]]. Strain into a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]] and rinse with cold water.
#While pasta is cooking, in a heavy [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat. Once bubbling ceases, whisk in flour and cook, whisking continuously, until blonde.
#Add remaining ingredients except butter. Once cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, add 1 tbsp butter, whisking continuously until melted. Repeat until all butter has been used.
#Gently [[Cookbook:Folding|fold]] in macaroni and serve warm.

== See also ==

* [[Cookbook:Macaroni and Cheese|Macaroni and Cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:Macaroni and Cheese (Baked)|Macaroni and Cheese (baked)]]
